stem: Voltmarkt's first-click figures for paid search match nothing in the Google Ads interface. What is the most likely reason?

options.text: Google Ads has dropped the first-click model, so it has no such figure to show
Google Ads applies a fixed 90-day lookback window that Voltmarkt's own data does not
Google Ads credits impressions to the first touch, while Voltmarkt credits clicks
Google Ads counts only orders from new customers, so its totals are smaller
